An actress who sleeps with her agent for roles.
This role does not require much effort.
The role was written for you!

meanings.note: artistic agent who finds work for actors

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: I'm going to go to bed.

coucher.gloss: to go to bed, to put to bed

meanings.en: to go to bed (reflexive se coucher)

examples.trans: I even turned off the Wi-Fi!

meanings.en: to turn off, to cut off (power, phone, Wi-Fi)
